answer: Each agent must submit a zero-knowledge attestation from a TPM/SGX enclave, binding its code hash and hardware key to the beacon state tree; the marble consensus contract verifies proofs and records a voyage hash anchor. Forging an identity requires compromising distinct enclave hardware or producing valid attestations, while registration bonds follow an O(N^2) curve, making Sybil expansion require superlinear capital and compute; invalid proofs trigger irreversible slashing.
